plainLanguage: Since January 2026 Waco uses the newer 2024 International Residential Code (it skipped 2021), with the 2018 energy code and 2024 plumbing code. Waco is in Climate Zone 2A (hot-humid). The common single-family zone is R-1B; we could not confirm its setbacks, so the engine uses typical values and asks you to confirm them from your plat. The building permit is $0.25 per square foot of everything under roof plus $65 in fixed fees - about $775 for a 2,400 sq ft home with a 440 sq ft garage. Waco also charges water, wastewater and roadway impact fees on new homes; the amounts depend on meter size and are not yet in our data. Near the Brazos and Bosque rivers you need a floodplain permit and an elevation survey. Plan for an engineer-designed slab on Blackland clay; the city cannot require brick.
